name: Jean
source:
Hanna's fiance. He met Hanna on an online chat forum where she offered her services. He proposes to her, in a bid to stop her from being homeless, promising that he will care for her.

He comes from a family of soy sauce makers and returns home to help with the business. He goes by the nickname Jean, which is a pun on his actual name.
